mapper.select: SELECT r.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, s.name AS supplier_name FROM mes_mrp_result r JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = r.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = r.supplier_id WHERE r.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY r.level_no, m.code
mapper.insert:
